name: Java Snippet Validation

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml'
      - 'scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh'
      - 'scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh'

jobs:
  validate-snippets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 8
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '8'

      - name: Check for script-only changes
        id: changed_files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v44
        with:
          files: |
            scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh
            scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh
            .github/workflows/java-snippet-validation.yml

      - name: Extract Java snippets
        if: steps.changed_files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/snippets
          scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh CodenameOne/src > /tmp/snippets/snippets.jsonl

      - name: Validate snippets
        if: steps.changed_files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          total_snippets=0
          failed_snippets=0
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            ((total_snippets++))
            echo "Validating snippet $total_snippets..."
            if ! echo "$line" | jq -r '.code' | scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Failed to validate snippet $total_snippets"
              ((failed_snippets++))
            fi
          done < /tmp/snippets/snippets.jsonl
          
          if [ $failed_snippets -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "Validation failed: $failed_snippets out of $total_snippets snippets failed validation"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "All $total_snippets snippets validated successfully"
          fi
